title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing the protective bond
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam  highlighting the auspicious power and blessings of Raksha (the protective bond/thread):
"एष प्रभावो रक्षायाः कथितस्ते युधिष्ठिर।
जयदः सुखदश्चैव पुत्रारोग्यधनप्रदः॥"
The Prime Minister posted on X:
एष प्रभावो रक्षायाः कथितस्ते युधिष्ठिर।
जयदः सुखदश्चैव पुत्रारोग्यधनप्रदः॥
एष प्रभावो रक्षायाः कथितस्ते युधिष्ठिर। जयदः सुखदश्चैव पुत्रारोग्यधनप्रदः॥ pic.twitter.com/dKLWCdmqcf — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 28, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/VJ

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (verse) on social media platform X highlighting the protective and auspicious power of 'Raksha', likely in connection with the Raksha Bandhan festival. The verse, addressed to Yudhishthira, describes the blessing as bringing victory, happiness, and prosperity including sons, health and wealth.
enrichment.context: This is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing a cultural/religious verse, likely timed around the Raksha Bandhan festival which celebrates familial protective bonds. Such posts are common practice for the PMO to connect with cultural and religious sentiments of citizens and have no policy or governance content.
